# The save kitten as my-nvim draws it (tests/test_kitten.py); do not edit.
case 12 40 notes.org
frame
~                            /\_/\      |
~                           ( o.o )     |
~                            > ^ <      |
frame
~                            /\_/\      |
~                           ( -.- )     |
~                            > ^ <      |
frame
~                            /\_/\      |
~                           ( o.o )_    |
~                            > ^ <      |
frame
~                            /\_/\      |
~                           ( ^.^ )__   |
~                            > ^ <      |
frame
~                            /\_/\      |
~                           ( ^.^ )__o  |
~                            > ^ <      |
frame
~             /\_/\   <3                |
~            ( ^.^ )__o                 |
~             > ^ <    saved notes.org  |
